name: One Eye Open (Louis Porter Jr)
body:
You sleep with one eye open.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Alertness

Benefit: You may make Perception checks while sleeping without penalty.

Normal: The DC for Perception checks made while asleep increases by 10.
